_method: Hand judgements. estimated_precision = ai_context_share + (1 - ai_context_share) * (fraction of the no-core-term sample that is really about AI). Keywords sampled at 40 tweets (>=500 originals) or 15 (50-499); keywords already above 60% ai_context_share were not sampled and are judged from their context share and the unambiguity of the string, which is noted in the reason.

AI.reason: 907k originals, the single largest AI signal; 38/40 no-context samples are about AI in 9 languages.
AI.false_positives: Portuguese/Spanish all-caps exclamation 'AI!' ('AI NAO AGUENTO', 'AI EU TO APAIXONADA') - ~5%.

A.I..reason: 3,330 originals, 33/40 sampled are AI; low volume but clean enough to keep.
A.I..false_positives: diplomatic 'charge d'affaires a.i.' (Latin ad interim) and dotted acronyms such as f.a.i.t.h.

AGI.false_positives: $AGI meme tokens and Allianz Global Investors (AGI).

LLM.reason: 25,274 originals, 40/40 sampled are about language models.

AI safety.reason: 93.7% of its tweets already carry another core AI term; unambiguous phrase.

AI bubble.reason: 91.4% ai_context_share; unambiguous phrase and a real discourse theme (peak 2026-09-14).

AI art.reason: 76% ai_context_share; note the hashtag form #AIart is caught by the AI keyword, not by this pattern.

AI agent.reason: 30,375 originals, 95.4% ai_context_share - one of the cleanest high-volume terms.

agentic.reason: 16,214 originals, 40/40 sampled use it in the AI-agent sense.
agentic.false_positives: none, but ~20% is crypto 'agentic economy/finance' token marketing.

neural network.reason: 1,021 originals, 35/40 sampled are the AI sense.
neural network.false_positives: the biological sense (brains, embryos, 'strengthen your neural networks').

prompt.reason: 53,133 originals but only 31/40 sampled are AI prompts; this is why bare 'prompt' was left out of the CORE set.
prompt.false_positives: creative-writing prompts (#prompt #WritingCommunity), 'prompt' meaning punctual/immediate ('prompt action', 'he was prompt'), Windows prompts.

RAG.reason: 2,260 originals, 30/40 sampled are retrieval-augmented generation; 52% already sit in AI context.
RAG.false_positives: RAG FAIR (Japanese band), Kyoto live house RAG, ACDC RAG (fashion brand), a racial slur.

IA.reason: 70,009 originals and only 3% English - the dominant AI word in Spanish/Portuguese/French/Italian; 35/40 sampled.
IA.false_positives: Iowa's postal abbreviation and Portuguese imperfect 'ia' inside all-caps text.

inteligencia artificial.reason: 8,409 originals, 40/40; covers Spanish and Portuguese spellings.

人工知能.reason: 3,567 originals, 40/40; covers JA/ZH/KO spellings of 'artificial intelligence'.

ИИ.reason: 1,547 originals, 40/40 Russian; needs the Unicode-boundary pattern because RE2's \b is ASCII-only.

OpenAI.reason: 37,738 originals, 52% already in AI context, 38/40 of the rest are the lab.

Anthropic.reason: 26,910 originals, 40/40; reproduces the team's earlier originals count (26,911) almost exactly.

DeepMind.reason: 1,026 originals at 62% ai_context_share; the string is unambiguous so it was not sampled.

Mistral.reason: 1,025 originals but only 18/40 sampled are the lab.
Mistral.false_positives: Gabriela Mistral and Frederic Mistral (poets), the mistral wind, Bugatti Mistral, Mistral Data (rail software).

Qwen.reason: 12,649 originals, 40/40; prefix pattern catches qwen3.8, qwen2.5 etc.

Moonshot.reason: 3,241 originals but 0/40 sampled are Moonshot AI.
Moonshot.false_positives: the Moonshot crypto launchpad ('vote to list $X on Moonshot'), baseball moonshots, the ordinary idiom. Use 'Kimi' or 'Moonshot AI' instead.

Kimi.reason: 21,254 originals but only 5/40 sampled are the model; its 2026-09-06 'peak' (lift 10.8) is the Italian GP, not an AI event.
Kimi.false_positives: F1 driver Kimi Antonelli, Turkish 'kimi' (=whom), anime titles. 'Kimi K3' is standalone-safe.

Perplexity.reason: 2,262 originals at 61% ai_context_share; the ordinary English noun is rare.

Nvidia.false_positives: GeForce gaming/laptop listings, Linux distro notes, NVIDIA Broadcast audio - about 12%.

Hugging Face.reason: 7,766 originals, 40/40; peak lift 9.8 (the Nvidia acquisition and the agent-swarm incident).

Runway.reason: 7,971 originals but 1/40 sampled are the AI company.
Runway.false_positives: fashion runways, airport runways, startup 'runway' (cash). Use RunwayML instead.

RunwayML.reason: 243 originals, 15/15 sampled; the precise form of the ambiguous 'Runway'.

Character.reason: 233,169 originals and 0/40 sampled are Character.AI - the second-largest term in the study and almost pure noise.

Cohere.false_positives: the English verb 'cohere' ('does not cohere'), a Berlin gallery.

SSI.reason: 616 originals, 7/40 sampled are Ilya Sutskever's lab.
SSI.false_positives: Social Security Income, SSI Football (US high school), Vietnam's SSI Securities, surgical site infection, NASA/SSI image credits.

safe superintelligence.reason: only 25 originals - too small to sample, but the phrase is unambiguous.

Figure AI.reason: 143 originals at 78% ai_context_share after the pattern was tightened; 7/8 spot-checked are the robotics company.
Figure AI.false_positives: pattern originally allowed 'Figure 2'/'Figure 3' and matched paper captions and action-figure 2-packs; now requires 'Figure AI', 'Figure 02' or 'Figure 03'.

Figure.reason: 71,992 originals, 0/40 sampled are the robotics company.
Figure.false_positives: 'figure out', action figures, 'public figure', 'six-figure'. Use Figure AI.

Palantir.reason: 4,100 originals and high entity precision, but only ~1 in 4 is AI discourse.
Palantir.false_positives: surveillance politics and $PLTR stock chatter dominate; the company is AI-adjacent rather than AI-topical.

Baidu.reason: 387 originals; roughly half the sample is the AI/robotaxi company, the rest corporate or fandom.
Baidu.false_positives: Baidu Baike/Tieba cited as a source, K-pop fandom, listing/ad-market news.

Hunyuan.reason: 82 originals, 13/15 sampled are Tencent's model family.

MiniMax.reason: 6,822 originals, 39/40 sampled are the lab (H3 video model).
MiniMax.false_positives: the minimax algorithm in statistics/game theory.

Replit.false_positives: a few '#REPLIT withdrawal scam' spam posts.

Windsurf.reason: 241 originals at 51% ai_context_share, 11/15 sampled are the editor.
Windsurf.false_positives: the watersport and a Cabo San Lucas hotel hashtag.

Lovable.reason: 2,230 originals but only 13/40 sampled are the company.

Devin.reason: 4,892 originals, 3/40 sampled are the coding agent.
Devin.false_positives: Devin Booker (NBA), Devin Haney (boxing), Devin Hester, Devin Witherspoon - US sports dominates.

Manus.reason: 1,002 originals, 29/40 sampled are the agent product.
Manus.false_positives: Dark Souls' boss Manus, 'Marathi Manus' (Mumbai politics), Warhammer lore.

Suno.reason: 6,999 originals, 37/40 sampled are the AI music tool.

Udio.reason: 62 originals after the pattern was fixed; 7/8 spot-checked are the AI music company.
Udio.false_positives: the first pattern used \budio\b, and because RE2's \b is ASCII-only it matched Portuguese 'audio'/'Claudio' 6,352 times at ~2% precision; a Unicode boundary fixes it.

Synthesia.reason: 73 originals, 2/15 sampled are the AI video company.
Synthesia.false_positives: Synthesia the piano-roll tutorial software dominates; also a Czech chemicals firm.

Luma.false_positives: lu.ma event links, LUMA Energy (Puerto Rico), and Turkish 'ogluma' (ASCII \b lands right after the non-ASCII 'g').

Pika.false_positives: Portuguese vulgar slang 'pika', Pokemon, the $PIKA token.

Sakana AI.reason: 431 originals, 0/15 sampled are the lab (its 37% ai_context_share is Japanese AI-art posts that happen to contain 'fish').
Sakana AI.false_positives: Japanese 'sakana' (=fish), the band sora tob sakana, VTuber 'H2o Sakana'.

Thinking Machines.reason: 126 originals, 9/15 sampled are Mira Murati's lab.
Thinking Machines.false_positives: the generic phrase (Burroughs quote, 'Butlerian Jihad', song lyrics).

Waymo.reason: 3,275 originals, 40/40 sampled; autonomy rather than genAI discourse.

Apple Intelligence.reason: 340 originals, 15/15 sampled; peak lift 8.5 around the iOS 27 launch.

ChatGPT.reason: 69,395 originals, 40/40 sampled, 43% English - the most reliable single product name.

GPT-4.reason: 924 originals, 40/40; most of it is the #keep4o campaign.

GPT-6.reason: 4,732 originals, 40/40; sharpest spike in the study (lift 177 on 2026-09-04, the GPT-6 Astra launch).

Sora.reason: 7,410 originals, 1/40 sampled are OpenAI's Sora (which is being retired in this month's corpus).
Sora.false_positives: Kingdom Hearts' Sora, Japanese given names and VTubers (Tokino Sora), the Italian town Sora.

Claude.reason: 83,799 originals, 39/40 sampled; 4th-largest AI term after AI/Grok/ChatGPT.
Claude.false_positives: the given name (Claude Monet; an otome-game love interest).

Gemini.reason: 46,741 originals but only 28/40 of the no-context sample is the model.
Gemini.false_positives: the zodiac sign and Thai actor Gemini Norawit (GMMTV fandom). 'Gemini Pro/Flash/3.x' is standalone-safe.

Grok.false_positives: almost none, but note most are @grok bot invocations rather than discussion about AI.

Llama.reason: 23,483 originals, 2/40 sampled are the model (only llama.cpp); 94% non-English.

Veo.reason: 54,168 originals, 1/40 sampled are Google's Veo; only 0.7% English.

o3.reason: 805 originals, 21/40 sampled are the model (there is a real farewell wave as o3 is retired).
o3.false_positives: sports-betting over/under lines ('Skubal o3.5 Ks'), closing times ('l.o3:30'), the :o3 emoticon.

R1.false_positives: tennis Round 1, South African Rand amounts (R1.5bn), Yamaha R1, a cartel alias, R1 research universities. Use 'DeepSeek'.

Codex.reason: 35,511 originals, 40/40 sampled - in this corpus Codex is a top-5 AI product and the medieval/game senses never appeared.

Gemma.false_positives: the given name (EastEnders, Love Island, Mexican reality TV), Italian 'gemma' (=gem/bud), Austrian 'gemma' (=let's go). 'Gemma 4' is standalone-safe.

Sonnet.reason: 1,977 originals, 26/40 sampled are the Claude model.
Sonnet.false_positives: Shakespeare and poetry, Korean singer Son Seung-yeon ('Sonnet'), Sonnet Technologies docks.

Opus.reason: 12,119 originals, 29/40 sampled are the Claude model.
Opus.false_positives: 'magnum opus', Opus Dei, Opus X cigars, classical opus numbers.

Haiku.reason: 2,323 originals, 3/40 sampled are the Claude model.
Haiku.false_positives: the poetry form and its very active hashtag community. Use 'Claude Haiku'.

DALL-E.reason: 243 originals after requiring the hyphen/middot; 8/8 spot-checked.
DALL-E.false_positives: the first pattern allowed 'dall e' and matched Italian 'dalle' (=from the) 6,038 times at 0/40 precision.

Imagen.reason: 24,443 originals, 0/40 sampled are Google's Imagen; 0.7% English.

Whisper.false_positives: the English verb and Netflix's 'The Whisper Man'.

Firefly.false_positives: Honkai Star Rail's Firefly, Firefly Aerospace, the NIO Firefly car, the TV show. Use 'Adobe Firefly'.

Siri.reason: 6,364 originals, 27/40 sampled are the assistant (much of it the 'hey Siri play X' meme).
Siri.false_positives: Japanese 尻/しり (=butt) puns, Swahili 'siri' (=secret), Malay 'siri' (=series), Portuguese 'siri' (=crab).

Alexa.reason: 7,572 originals, 10/40 sampled are about the assistant.
Alexa.false_positives: the 'alexa play X' meme format, Alexa Bliss (WWE), the given name, Alexa-compatible product listings.

Optimus.reason: 13,448 originals, 7/40 sampled are Tesla's robot; its 2026-08-27 spike (lift 16) is Peter Cullen's death, not an AI event.

MCP.reason: 9,638 originals, 38/40 sampled are Model Context Protocol - a genuinely new 2026 AI term.

deep research.reason: 653 originals, ~19/29 readable samples are the product rather than the phrase.
deep research.false_positives: the generic 'I did deep research' in crypto and finance posts.

Altman.reason: 4,012 originals, 28/40 sampled are Sam Altman; 'sam altman' alone is standalone-safe.
Altman.false_positives: Robert Altman (director), Breno Altman (Brazilian journalist), Koby Altman (NBA), Howard Altman (reporter).

Amodei.reason: 1,186 originals at 77% ai_context_share, peak lift 67 on 2026-09-12; unambiguous surname.

Hinton.false_positives: Myles Hinton (NFL), S.E. Hinton (author), Anthony Ray Hinton, Hinton (town). Use 'Geoffrey Hinton'.

Murati.false_positives: Eva Murati (Albanian TV presenter), footballers Al Musrati/Murati. Use 'Mira Murati'.

Suleyman.false_positives: Sultan Suleyman (Magnificent Century fandom) and Turkish given names.

Elon Musk.false_positives: politics, Starlink, engagement-bait quizzes and impersonation scams. He belongs to the AI story but the name does not select for it.

AIイラスト.reason: DISCOVERED. 53,927 originals at 96% ai_context_share and 3% English - the largest AI-art community tag in the corpus, bigger than ChatGPT.

生成AI.reason: DISCOVERED. 24,564 originals at 99% ai_context_share; Japanese for 'generative AI'.

Claude Code.reason: DISCOVERED. 20,562 originals, 40/40 sampled; a top-10 AI term the seed list missed.

Sol.reason: DISCOVERED but unusable: 146,760 originals and 2/40 sampled are the model.
Sol.false_positives: Spanish/Portuguese 'sol' (=sun), Turkish 'sol' (=left), $SOL/Solana, given names. GPT-5.6 Sol is real, but so are Luna/Terra/Flare - OpenAI's model line uses words too generic to filter on. Use 'GPT-5'.

Astra.reason: DISCOVERED. 14,616 originals, 34/40 sampled; the GPT-6 codename, peak lift 44 on 2026-09-05.
Astra.false_positives: 'ad astra' in Latin mottos and brand names (Ad Astra Radio/Bread), the Astra Awards, an Arc Astra token.

Fable.reason: DISCOVERED. 15,864 originals, 29/40 sampled are the Claude Fable model.
Fable.false_positives: the Xbox game Fable (Feb 2027 release), the Fable book-club app, Aesop's fable. 'Claude Fable' / 'Fable 5' are standalone-safe.

Seedance.reason: DISCOVERED. 9,313 originals, 40/40 sampled; ByteDance's video model.

Grok Imagine.false_positives: '@grok Imagine playing vs the Jets' - the word 'imagine' after a @grok mention.

physical AI.reason: DISCOVERED. 5,187 originals at 96% ai_context_share - the robotics wing of the AI conversation.

generative AI.reason: DISCOVERED. 3,555 originals at 81% ai_context_share - a plain miss from the seed list.

harness.reason: DISCOVERED. 9,753 originals, 31/40 sampled use the new 'coding harness'/'agent harness' sense.
harness.false_positives: the verb 'harness the power of', wiring/horse/body harnesses, a $HARNESS token.

OpenRouter.reason: DISCOVERED. 4,539 originals, 40/40 sampled; the Stripe acquisition drove much of it.

PixAI.reason: DISCOVERED. 4,565 originals, 40/40 sampled; 12% English (Japanese AI-art community).

GLM.reason: DISCOVERED. 8,088 originals, 37/40 sampled are Z.ai's model family.
GLM.false_positives: a Japanese Lolita-fashion event abbreviated GLM.

OAI.reason: DISCOVERED. 1,652 originals at 73% ai_context_share; the common abbreviation of OpenAI.
OAI.false_positives: roughly 30% of the volume is a single review-scraping bot template ('DS vs OAI Said,{...}'), which is AI-related but low value.

Wan.reason: DISCOVERED. 2,633 originals, 38/40 sampled; Alibaba's video model, matched as 'wan <digit>'.
Wan.false_positives: a Hindi sentence and an @Wan handle.

Apodex.reason: DISCOVERED. 797 originals, 39/40 sampled; an agentic lab (Apodex 1.1) absent from the seed list, peak lift 16.

Claudeforce.reason: DISCOVERED. 362 originals at 64% ai_context_share; the Salesforce x Anthropic product, peak lift 11 on 2026-08-27.

Nscale.reason: DISCOVERED. 414 originals at 78% ai_context_share; the AI cloud in Anthropic's $45B compute deal, peak lift 15.

Nebius.reason: DISCOVERED. 1,164 originals, 40/40 sampled are the AI cloud.

HUMAIN.reason: DISCOVERED. 435 originals at 60% ai_context_share; Saudi Arabia's AI company, peak lift 22. Matched case-sensitively on purpose.

Vera Rubin.reason: DISCOVERED. 1,316 originals, 40/40 sampled are Nvidia's GPU platform; the astronomer/observatory sense never appeared.

AI Mode.reason: DISCOVERED. 498 originals at 94% ai_context_share; Google's AI Mode in Search.

keep4o.reason: DISCOVERED. 2,005 originals, 40/40 sampled; the campaign to restore GPT-4o and a distinct community the seed list missed entirely.

deep learning.false_positives: a racehorse named Deep Learning; Indonesia's school-curriculum use of the English phrase.

LLMO.reason: DISCOVERED. 406 originals at 65% ai_context_share and only 2% English - a Japanese SEO-for-LLMs term.

Aschenbrenner.reason: DISCOVERED. 373 originals, 13/15 sampled; almost all about the collapse of his $45B AI fund, peak lift 9.9.
